answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the relic of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The ivory is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the lagoon.
